lead: VRAM Sherpa estimates whether a model variant can fit on your available VRAM for local inference. It is a planning estimate, not a benchmark.
Llama 3.1 8B Instruct at Q4, with a 2048-token context. See its model page.
390-light.pane: Fits 16.7 GB spare 7.33 GB needed 24.0 GB How this is estimated
390-light.why: How this is estimated Q4 on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct Model weights 4.95 GB Context memory (KV cache) 0.98 GB Runtime overhead 1.40 GB Total needed 7.33 GB Safety reserve Kept free, not part of the total 2.40 GB
